responsibility: This definition module declares the legacy PIM FileSystem API for GNU Modula-2. It owns the File record layout, response and mode flag enumerations, and procedures for opening, creating, renaming, deleting, positioning, reading, writing, and flushing files at word, byte, character, and raw-address levels, providing a stateful low-level file abstraction distinct from the simpler terminal-oriented InOut layer.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the FileSystem pair: it defines the public File record, enums, and low-level file operation signatures, while FileSystem.mod supplies the backing behavior on top of FIO/SFIO/libc.
